variant.description: Some mounts have really cool BGM tracks (Cruise Chaser FTW) while others are almost sickening in how much you hear them. It's annoying to keep needing to use /mountbgm, but now you won't have to - just let the plugin do it for you!

variant.punchline: Automatically control mount BGM for individual mounts!
